status: Recording-ready Rift Keeper and eight class mentors

riftkeeper.name: Rift Keeper
riftkeeper.role: Explains the training rifts and their history

hall.keeper.intro.text: Five matching saved shards automatically open a training rift. Briar Town is first on your right; the others follow campaign order.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Warm male voice, patient and gently amused. Dry humor on the last line.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.welcome.text: Each frame shows its region, class, and saved shard count. What would you like to know?

choices.text: Where did these rifts come from?
What is waiting on the other side?

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Helpful and unhurried. Explain the visible room without sounding like a tutorial announcer.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.assemble.text: Save all five matching shards to open a portal automatically. Necromancer also requires completing Castle Duskmoor. You never need my help to assemble it.

choices.text: What counts as a saved piece?

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Careful concentration, then a small smile. Do not promise a portal opened: the player may have incomplete sets.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.origin.text: A Sunspire scholar threw the training rifts from the palace to save them from the Legion. They shattered across Aerth.

choices.text: So the scholar saved them by breaking them?
Then we should put them back together.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Quiet respect. Do not name the scholar or claim who first created the rifts.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.scholar.text: Scattered shards could be recovered. In the Legion's hands, those fighting lessons would be lost.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Hopeful, with a restrained chuckle on deeply annoying. No prophecy or lineage reveal.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.training.text: A mentor waits inside each rift. Complete the trial to unlock that fighting style.

choices.text: Are these like the Hollow Gate?

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Clear, encouraging, lightly firm on the last sentence. These mentors are not all dead Bladeborn.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.difference.text: These purple rifts lead to training. The King's black Hollow Gate removes souls. They are different kinds of magic.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Serious but reassuring. No new explanation of how the Hollow Gate works or ending spoilers.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

hall.keeper.saving.text: Finish each level part to save its shards. Death loses only unsaved ones. In co-op, each player must collect world shards themselves.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Plain and practical. This is checkpoint guidance, not a new magical law.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
